'''Adikaria''' was a celestial body<ref name="Cleansing the Seas" /> located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Adikaria system/Legends|Adikaria system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Its surface featured [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] that were at one point inhabited by giant [[Water/Legends|sea]] creatures. During the early period of exploration of Adikaria, a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] sank in the oceans.<ref name="Cleansing the Seas" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Cleansing the Seas" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Adikaria had been inhabited for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an environmental cleanup operation was carried out on the celestial body, which included the dredging of its oceans.<ref name="Cleansing the Seas" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
An individual affiliated with one of the sides in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to participate in the latter process in hopes of obtaining valuable finds. The companion discovered large quantities of refuse and the remains of Adikaria's aquatic creatures, as well as the wrecked old underwater exploration vehicle.<ref name="Cleansing the Seas" />
{{Endgame}}

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CW" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the celestial body had become the point of origin of the Adikarian composition known as ''[[Greetings Between Equals]]''.<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adikaria was first indirectly mentioned in [[Karen Miller]]'s [[2010]] novel [[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth|''Stealth'']], the first entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Gambit]]'' novel duology.<ref name="CW" /> The celestial body was then fully identified in a Scavenging Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Cleansing the Seas" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Adikaria [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Adikaria itself, in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" />
